metadata.description: 面向 CLI agent 的公开通用 skills。

plugins.name: workflow-hub
plugins.description: 总工作流开放能力图谱：把 Idea、共创、Goal/Task 开发、PR、产品交付、复盘与叙事连接成可验收闭环。

plugins.name: linear-board
plugins.description: TIA Idea Inbox 与 Global Goal Status Board：收集想法、提升 Goal、同步状态与 Task checklist。

plugins.name: retro-loop
plugins.description: 双路复盘与三道物理锁：把 Telemetry/Crash 与 Workflow/PR/Infra 证据转成可验收 Task。

plugins.name: story-craft
plugins.description: 四元素叙事素材抽取、脱敏与 Story Series/Tech Blog/Deck 发布读回。

plugins.name: team-lead
plugins.description: 进行任何开发、架构或规格规划、UI/UX 设计或界面重设计、数据/指标或代码库调研、实现、Bug 修复、代码审查或 PR 交付前必须加载；按单任务或多任务 Goal 通过 1-Hop 子代理编排 Explorer -> Designer -> Writer -> Reviewer -> pr_monitor。

plugins.name: m2-dispatcher
plugins.description: M2-Dispatcher（常驻域主 Bot、Cindy 与交互式 CLI 入口）编排后台 Herdr Goal Steering (TL) 的生命周期合同：开 TL、热追加、巡检解卡与 Goal/Task 完结回收。

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review a branch, PR, worktree, or implementation handoff against both repository standards and feature intent. Use for implementer self-review or independent review when the target repo may contain Spec Kit artifacts and repo-kit files; preserves separate Standards and Spec axes, fans Standards review out by changed layer, checks cross-layer dependency direction, and reports cited findings without editing code.

plugins.name: xcode-cli
plugins.description: Route Apple-platform builds, tests, simulator runs, and result inspection through Swift and Xcode command-line tools. Use when Codex needs to build or test a Swift package, Xcode project, or workspace; diagnose Apple build failures; run an iOS simulator; choose between swift build/test and xcodebuild; or parse xcresult output. Package-only changes stay on SwiftPM commands and escalate to xcodebuild only when the diff includes app/Xcode integration work or the user explicitly requests integration verification. Not for Xcode MCP or GUI automation.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: 对任意主题做深度、多来源、经交叉核查的调研,产出带引用、按置信度分级的报告。五阶段流水线:把问题分解成 4-8 个子问题 → 跨渠道(web/github/news/academic)并行 fan-out 调研 → 对每个发现做对抗式核查(证伪而非确认,发现者≠核查者)→ 交叉验证+圆桌综合、标注分歧 → 输出 HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/CONTESTED 分级的引用报告。Provider-agnostic:同一份 skill 在 Claude Code、Kimi(kimi -p)、Codex(codex exec)三端都成立;fan-out 与核查阶段可跨模型互查(claude 的发现让 codex/kimi 证伪,反之亦然),对方模型作独立第二视角。当用户想「深度调研 / deep research / 全面调研 / 多角度调研 / research roundtable / 帮我把某主题查透并给带引用的报告」时使用。调用前:若问题欠具体(如「买什么车」却无预算/用途/地区),先问 2-3 个澄清问题收窄范围,再把澄清结果织进 args。

plugins.name: codebase-design
plugins.description: Shared vocabulary and discipline for designing deep modules and sharpening domain models. Use when designing or improving module interfaces, finding deepening opportunities, deciding seam placement, making code more testable or AI-navigable, refining ubiquitous language, writing or editing CONTEXT.md, or recording an ADR.

plugins.name: my-designer
plugins.description: Entry B of the Dual-Entry Design Flow: progressive-disclosure product design, UI modernization, and post-implementation Visual Traceback for desktop, mobile, and web.

plugins.name: design-studio
plugins.description: Entry A of the Dual-Entry Design Flow: ingest, classify, and stockpile design inspirations, measured palettes, interaction/motion patterns, and video assets.

plugins.name: skill-contract
plugins.description: Create and audit progressive-disclosure skills with four valves.
